body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not appropriately allow temporary changes in work, training, or education status, as required by 98.21(a)(1)(ii)(B), 98.21(a)(1)(ii)(C), 98.21(a)(1)(ii)(D), and 98.21(a)(1)(ii)(E). body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not limit all family co-payments to seven percent or less of family income, as required by 98.45(l)(3). (Plan Question 3.1.1a). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through August 1, 2026. • The Lead Agency does not provide data on the extent to which CCDF providers charge families additional amounts above the required co-payment (including data on the size and frequency of such amounts), as required by 98.45(b)(5). (Plan Question 3.1.2eii) Overall Target Completion Date: 09/30/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Determine fiscal impact for limiting co-payments 03/31/2025 2 Create survey to collect data on additional amounts providers charge families above the required co-payment 06/30/2025 3 Stakeholder engagement 06/30/2025 4 Survey child care providers 01/30/2026 5 Stakeholder engagement 01/30/2026 6 Create policy on limiting co-payments to 7% family income to be effective August 1, 2026 01/30/2026 7 Update to Child Care Data System (CCDS) based on new policy 06/30/2026 8 Create and finalize report based on survey results 06/30/2026 9 Train staff and providers on new policy and CCDS updates 06/30/2026 10 Message to stakeholders 06/30/2026 11 Public comment period for amendment 07/31/2026 12 Plan amendment to 3.1.1a and 3.1.2eii 09/30/2026

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not pay all providers in a timely manner. In addition, the Lead Agency does not pay all provider types prospectively or alternatively does not demonstrate that it is not a generally-accepted practice for all provider types, as required by 98.45(m)(1). (Plan Question 4.4.1a). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through August 1, 2026. • The Lead Agency does not pay based on enrollment or alternatively does not provide justification that this is impracticable or is not a generally-accepted practice, as required by 98.45(m)(2). (Plan Question 4.4.1b). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through August 1, 2026. • The Lead Agency does not pay for reasonable mandatory registration fees that the provider charges to private-paying parents, as required by 98.45(m)(4). (Plan Question 4.4.2b) Overall Target Completion Date: 09/30/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Determine fiscal impact for paying providers prospectively, paying on enrollment, and paying mandatory registration fees. 03/31/2025 2 Stakeholder engagement 01/30/2026 3 Create policies on paying providers prospectively, paying on enrollment, and paying registration fees to be effective August 1, 2026 01/30/2026 4 Updates to Child Care Data System (CCDS) based on new policies 06/30/2026 5 Train staff and providers on new policy and CCDS updates 06/30/2026 6 Message to stakeholders 06/30/2026 7 Public comment period for amendment 07/31/2026 8 Plan amendment to 4.4.1a., 4.4.1b., and 4.4.2. 09/30/2026

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency did not use a market rate survey or ACF pre-approved Alternative Methodology to set payment rates and does not certify that the percentiles reported in their CCDF Plan are based on their most recent MRS or ACF pre-approved Alternative Methodology, as required by 98.45(d)(1) and 98.45(f)(2)(i). (Plan Questions 4.2.1ei, 4.2.1eii, 4.2.1eiii, 4.2.1eiv, and 4.3.2b) • The Lead Agency has not yet completed the narrow cost analysis or estimated cost of care, as required by 98.45(f)(1)(ii). (Plan Questions 4.2.2a, 4.2.2b, 4.2.2c, and 4.2.2d) • The Lead Agency’s payment rates for infants in family child care homes, preschoolers in family child care homes, preschoolers in center-based care, and infants in center- based care are not sufficient to ensure equal access as they are not based on the most recent MRS, as required by 98.45(a). (Plan Question 4.3.2a) Overall Target Completion Date: 09/30/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Finalize and post 2024 MRS on website and begin narrow cost analysis 03/01/2025 2 Message to stakeholders 03/01/2025 3 Public comment period for amendment 03/31/2025 4 Plan amendment to 4.2 to include updated final report information 04/30/2025 5 Stakeholder engagement 06/30/2026 6 Message to stakeholders 06/30/2026 7 Complete narrow cost analysis 06/30/2026 8 Update payment rates based on 2024 MRS 07/31/2026 9 Public comment period for amendment 07/31/2026 10 Plan amendment to 4.2 and 4.3. 09/30/2026

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not require pre-service or orientation training on child development for licensed centers, licensed family child care homes, license-exempt centers, or license-exempt family child care homes, as required by 98.44(b)(1)(iii). (Plan Question 5.4.1l) • The Lead Agency does not require an annual unannounced inspection for licensed centers or licensed family child care homes or an annual inspection for license-exempt centers or license-exempt family child care homes for compliance with pre-service or orientation training requirements related to child development, as required by 98.42(b)(2)(i)(B) and 98.42(b)(2)(ii). body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not post full monitoring and inspection reports that include all areas of compliance and non-compliance for all licensed centers, licensed family child care providers, license-exempt centers, license-exempt family child care providers, license-exempt in-home providers, or out-of-school programs, as required by 98.33(a)(4).
